label: A scenario manifest is JSON with a ten-paraphrase set per case, n_runs 5, match_mode ordered_subset and inline setup files, so the case tests the behaviour not the prompt
Test discovery by module-name convention (a *postgres_tests module plus #[ignore]) is enforced by a guard script that blanks comments and literals before matching, so a new test needs no registration
A falsifiability standard for tests, each rule carrying the PR that produced it: a guard whose removal fails no test protects nothing
A skill-adherence eval embeds the skill body inline as a string, so the eval tests the text rather than whatever the skill file currently says
A residue linter keeps 13 labelled regexes for defects a prior round fixed, plus structural checks, and runs in --check mode as a pre-commit hook that exits 1 on any hit
A generated reference document is kept current by regenerating it in CI and running git diff --exit-code on the committed copy, so drift is impossible rather than reviewed

A removal-completeness linter scans prompts, templates, skills and the install doc for 27 removed action names, with a false-positive control: common words match only on a line naming the tool, distinctive names match anywhere
